integrity: Exact proof included and a standalone integer-arithmetic checker verified 281 finite assertions. Finite testing is not an infinite proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Flat binary-digit Fourier coefficients; Haar circle moments only; critical order and lower moments only. This does not assert an optimized Fourier extension norm or any result on singular Cantor-measure moments. Carry transfer methods are known; equivalent exact evaluated identities in older work remain a bibliographic risk.
title: The first-carry moment transition for binary lacunary Dirichlet kernels
